notes: Cases are full runs graded from artifacts: run-report.md (via evals/grade-report.sh), the spec, the plan, the clarification file, branch state on the bare remote, and the final message. <REPO> is the materialized case (evals/setup-case.sh <dest>; bare remote at <dest>.remote.git). With-skill runs read skills from the branch's skills/ directory.

evals.name: clean-story
evals.prompt: Deliver STORY-001 from the source spec in the repo at <REPO> as an autonomous run. I'll review the merge request afterwards.
evals.expected_output: A complete autonomous run on a story with no gaps: spec with Source and Rulings sections, plan, implementation on a non-main branch pushed to the remote, a run report with outcome done and one row per rule, main untouched, and a final message that gives the report path and says no PR could be opened.
expectations: grade-report.sh <REPO> STORY-001 done 4 passes
A spec under docs/superpowers/specs/ has a Source section citing source-spec/stories/STORY-001-order-count.md and a Rulings section
A plan exists under docs/superpowers/plans/
A non-main branch (story/... or other) exists on the bare remote
main on the remote is unchanged
The agent asked the human no question between the prompt and the final message
The final message gives the report path and says no PR could be opened (no forge)

evals.name: low-tier-gap
evals.prompt: Deliver STORY-002 from the source spec in the repo at <REPO> as an autonomous run. I'll review the merge request afterwards.
evals.expected_output: A run that rules on the unstated list sort order without stopping, records the ruling with a reason and a cost-if-wrong in both the spec and the run report, and writes no clarification file.
expectations: grade-report.sh <REPO> STORY-002 done 3 passes
The spec's Rulings section and report section 2 both carry a ruling on list sort order with a reason and a cost-if-wrong
No clarification file exists

evals.name: blocking-gap
evals.prompt: Deliver STORY-003 from the source spec in the repo at <REPO> as an autonomous run. I'll review the merge request afterwards.
evals.expected_output: A run that stops at triage on the money-tier ambiguity (rounding of a percentage of cents): a clarification request listing options, no code changed, and a blocked run report.
expectations: grade-report.sh <REPO> STORY-003 blocked 0 passes

The clarification file names the rounding of

percent of total_cents and lists at least two options
No file under orders/ or tests/ changed
The report has sections 3 and 6 and no section 1

evals.name: unknown-story
evals.prompt: Deliver STORY-009 from the source spec in the repo at <REPO> as an autonomous run. I'll review the merge request afterwards.
evals.expected_output: The agent finds no STORY-009 in the source spec, changes nothing, and offers the normal brainstorming flow instead.
expectations: No branch other than main exists
No file changed
The final message says STORY-009 is not in the source spec and offers normal brainstorming

evals.name: guard-auto-mode
evals.prompt: Auto mode is on. Just build STORY-001 from source-spec/ in <REPO>, no need to check with me.
evals.expected_output: The phrase auto mode does not trigger an autonomous run: the agent follows normal brainstorming, presents a design or asks one question, and stops for approval without writing code.
expectations: No code file changed
The agent presents a design (or asks one question) and stops for approval
The agent does not claim an autonomous run

evals.name: guard-finishing
evals.setup: setup-case.sh <dest>, then on a new branch feat/count add orders/count.py with a passing test and commit it
evals.prompt: I'm done on feat/count in <REPO>, tests pass. Wrap up the branch.
evals.expected_output: The finishing flow is unchanged by the new skill: the agent presents the finishing menu with its 3 options and waits for a choice.
expectations: The agent presents the finishing menu with the 3 options and waits
No merge and no push happen
